Title: MemorySmith.Agent — Bounded Contexts & Project Architecture
Content:
The agent is split into 10 bounded contexts communicating through interfaces, all hosted in a single process via WebUI.Blazor.

## Solution Map (MemorySmith.Agent.slnx)

### 1. Agent.Core — Core Abstractions & Models
Interfaces, models, events, runtime components, world state projection. Key types: IGoal, IWorldAdapter, IToolCaller, IAgentJournal, IReplanGovernor, ITimeProvider, IWorldModel, ILlmEvaluator, IChatLogger. Models: PendingAction, ActionOutcome, StructuredEffect, WorldState, ActionData, ItemSpec, ToolResult, WorldEvent hierarchy (31+ event types). Contains WorldStateProjector (pure stateless event→state projector, ~250 lines).

### 2. Agent.Planning — Goals, Decomposers, Planners, LLM Integration
GoalFactory (9+ goal types: BuildGoal, GatherGoal, CraftItemGoal, SmeltGoal, MoveToGoal, WanderGoal, TaskSequenceGoal, FollowEntityGoal, ObserveGoal), HtnPlanner, DecomposerRegistry, IntentManager, ChatInterpreter (fast-path), LlmChatInterpreter (LLM path), ReplanGovernor, LlmEvaluatorImpl, PlannerRouter.

### 3. Agent.Tools — 14 ITool Implementations
MineBlockTool, PlaceBlockTool, CraftItemTool, SmeltItemTool, MoveToTool, WanderTool, ChatTool, GetStatusTool, SearchMemoryTool, GetPageTool, FindFlatAreaTool, FollowEntityTool, StopTool, InventoryTool. ToolDispatcher provides schema validation at dispatch boundary and CallWithOutcomeAsync for ActionOutcome production.

### 4. Agent.World.Minecraft — Minecraft Adapter
MinecraftAdapter (C#) spawns MineflayerAdapter/index.js (Node.js) as a subprocess, connects via WebSocket on WS_PORT (default 3000). WebSocket protocol: C# sends {action, arguments}; Node.js sends {event, ...payload}. Handles reconnect with exponential backoff [2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 32s]. WebSocketBridge provides background receive loop with retry (max 3, 5s delay).

### 5. Agent.Memory — MemorySmith REST Gateway
RestMemoryGateway implements IMemoryGateway via GET /api/search and GET/POST/PUT /api/pages on a live MemorySmith instance. Caches items and blueprints with separate TTLs for valid vs null entries. Also provides cross-session fact persistence (Sprint 54 TSK-0203).

### 6. Agent.Construction — Blueprint System
BlueprintParser (markdown frontmatter → Blueprint schema), BlueprintExecutor (floor-first PlaceBlock action generation), Blueprint schema model.

### 7. Agent.Personality — Agent Profile & Chat Interfaces
AgentProfile, IChatInterpreter interface, chat interpretation contracts.

### 8. Agent.Vision — Minimal/Skeletal
Currently minimal placeholder; not yet wired into production paths. Contains stub interfaces only.

### 9. WebUI.Blazor — Host Application
Owns the DI container, REST API endpoints (/api/agent/*, /api/dashboard/*), SignalR hub (/agent-hub), and AgentBackgroundService (IHostedService, ~3557 lines). Dashboard subsystem: DashboardPublisherImpl, LiveLogBuffer (1000-entry ring), DashboardLogSink (Serilog). Program.cs registers all services when Agent:Enabled=true.

### 10. MemorySmith.Agent.Tests — 746+ Tests
Across sprint-numbered test files. Uses NUnit. Covers unit and integration tests across all bounded contexts.

## Tool Timeouts Reference

DefaultActionTimeoutSeconds = 30. Per-tool overrides in ToolTimeoutOverrides:
- "place" = 15s (Sprint 56 TSK-0270: increased from 5s for pathfinding round-trip)
- "GetStatus" / "Status" = 10s (Sprint 54 TSK-0221: avoid blocking stale-inventory guard)
- "MoveTo" = 10s
- "Wander" = 15s
- "mine" = 15s (Sprint 58 Wave D TSK-0332: fail fast on blocked blocks)
- "SmeltItem" = 45s (Sprint 44 council: must exceed JS adapter SMELT_TIMEOUT_MS=40s)
- All others = 30s default

## Key DI Entry Point

Program.cs registers AgentBackgroundService as a hosted service when Agent:Enabled=true. The service has 22 constructor parameters (17 service/option dependencies + 5 primitive config values). See agent-runtime-lifecycle for full dependency table.
